visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a white beanie and a red hoodie stands in a modern, dimly lit living room with large glass windows. She holds a shiny red gift bag while smiling at the camera. A large television in the background displays a music performance. (2) The camera pans to a brown leather sofa where several other young women are seated, each holding similar red gift bags. They begin tearing into the crinkly red packaging with excited facial expressions and energetic movements. (3) A close-up reveals a purple Teletubbies plush toy being pulled from the wrapping. The characters are laughing and gesturing toward the toy. (4) The scene shifts to show a woman in a white sweatshirt laughing hysterically while wearing a yellow Teletubby-style headpiece with a curved antenna. The group continues to interact on the sofa, displaying their gifts. (5) Transition to a brightly lit, sterile indoor room resembling a dance studio or cafeteria with yellow and grey tables. The woman in the white sweatshirt and yellow hat performs a rhythmic dance, swinging her hair and smiling. (6) The setting returns to the living room restaurant area at night. Staff members approach carrying a cake topped with fruit and lit candles. A woman in a tan hooded jacket looks shocked and claps her hands in surprise. (7) The woman in tan holds the cake as the group gathers around her. She makes a wish and speaks to the others with a joyous expression. (8) Close-up on the cake, which has a chocolate plaque that says 'Happy Birthday'. The woman blows out the candles as pink heart overlays appear on the screen. (9) The woman waves at the camera while holding the cake, and the video concludes with the group celebrating.
